def fleiss_kappa_from_votes(vote_dist):
    """
    vote_dist: list of dicts, each {category: count}
    Compute Fleiss' kappa.
    """
    # Get all categories
    all_cats = set()
    for v in vote_dist:
        all_cats.update(v.keys())
    all_cats = sorted(all_cats)
    
    N = len(vote_dist)  # number of subjects (problems)
    
    # Build matrix: N x k
    matrix = []
    for v in vote_dist:
        row = [v.get(c, 0) for c in all_cats]

    matrix = np.array(matrix, dtype=float)
    
    n_raters_per = matrix.sum(axis=1)  # number of raters per subject
